answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 58980 Country: India Title: income tax and bank interst Question: (1) Is it lawful to pay income tax by the amount received as interest on bank savings? (2) I have taken a credit card from bank by which I can take loan from bank for 40 days and if I pay it back within 40 days I will not be charged any interest. Bank takes only charges of this facility say Rs 500/= per annum. Is this transaction lawful? Answer ID: 58980 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 381/381/SD=07/1436) (1) Yes, it is allowable to pay income tax with interest money. (2) If no interest charge is levied then it is allowable to transact with credit card. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
